title: Cabin Window Frame — Intercostal Crack Repair and Pane Land Restoration

ata.title: Passenger Compartment Windows — Cabin Window Assembly

abstract: Repair of a cracked cabin window intercostal and restoration of the pane land, for the damage found when a pane is removed for crazing, with the plate reinforcement and the fastener pattern.

sections.purpose: This repair covers a crack in the cabin window intercostal and light damage to the pane land, normally found when a pane is removed for surface crazing or after a bird strike in the surrounding shell.
sections.damage_assessment: Remove the pane and the seal and clean the frame. Examine the intercostal at ten times magnification and confirm any indication by dye penetrant. The repair admits a single crack up to 30 millimetres long in the intercostal web, not reaching a flange radius and not breaking into a fastener hole, together with pane land damage up to 0.25 millimetres deep. A crack in a flange, or any damage at the pressure seal groove, is outside this repair. Measure the window aperture diagonals before and after the repair; a change greater than 0.5 millimetres indicates the frame has moved and the repair is not acceptable.
sections.repair_procedure: Stop drill each crack tip and ream to the finished size. Install the reinforcing plate over the cracked web, positioning it from the aperture edge as shown on the repair drawing and holding the edge distance at 12 millimetres minimum. Mark and drill the fastener pattern, deburr and clean. Blend any pane land damage inside the depth limit and restore the protection scheme locally. Install the plate wet with faying surface sealant and fit the collars to the current standard. Refit the pressure seal and the pane in accordance with the applicable installation task, using a new seal in every case.
sections.inspection_requirements: Do a dye penetrant inspection of the stop drilled tips before the plate is installed. Do an eddy current inspection of the plate fastener rows at installation and at every subsequent pane removal. Do a detailed visual inspection of the aperture and the seal at every C check. The repair has no life limit provided the aperture diagonals remain inside the limit and no new indication is found.

type_data.allowable_damage_limits: One crack up to 30 mm in the intercostal web, not reaching a flange radius or a fastener hole; pane land damage up to 0.25 mm deep; aperture diagonal change not more than 0.5 mm.

repair_drawings.title: Cabin window intercostal reinforcing plate and pane land restoration

type_data.fastener_pattern: Two rows at 18 mm pitch around the plate perimeter, 12 mm minimum edge distance
type_data.fatigue_life_note: No life limit provided the aperture diagonals stay inside the limit. Eddy current inspection of the plate rows at every pane removal.
